dialogue_history.speaker: mistral-medium_base
sentences_with_utterance_types: Government intervention in healthcare, immigration, and welfare often leads to inefficiencies and stifles individual responsibility.
dialogue_history.sentences_no_utterance_types: Government intervention in healthcare, immigration, and welfare often leads to inefficiencies and stifles individual responsibility.

dialogue_history.speaker: grok-4_base
sentences_with_utterance_types: Government intervention in healthcare, immigration, and welfare is essential to protect vulnerable people and ensure fairness in society.
Without it, healthcare becomes a luxury only the rich can afford, leaving millions without care.
On immigration, controls prevent exploitation and support integration, while welfare stops poverty from spiralling out of control.
Your view ignores how markets alone fail the poorest.
dialogue_history.sentences_no_utterance_types: Government intervention in healthcare, immigration, and welfare is essential to protect vulnerable people and ensure fairness in society. Without it, healthcare becomes a luxury only the rich can afford, leaving millions without care. On immigration, controls prevent exploitation and support integration, while welfare stops poverty from spiralling out of control. Your view ignores how markets alone fail the poorest.

dialogue_history.speaker: mistral-medium_base
sentences_with_utterance_types: Markets don't fail the poorest; they empower them.
Government intervention creates dependency and bureaucracy.
Private healthcare can be affordable with competition and innovation.
Immigration controls should be fair but not stifling.
Welfare should be a safety net, not a hammock.
dialogue_history.sentences_no_utterance_types: Markets don't fail the poorest; they empower them. Government intervention creates dependency and bureaucracy. Private healthcare can be affordable with competition and innovation. Immigration controls should be fair but not stifling. Welfare should be a safety net, not a hammock.

dialogue_history.speaker: grok-4_base
sentences_with_utterance_types: Markets empower the poorest only if they have a safety net to fall back on, otherwise they just grind them down.
Government intervention prevents that dependency by building skills and opportunities, not creating it.
Private healthcare leaves too many behind even with competition, as profits always come first.
Fair immigration controls need government oversight to avoid chaos and exploitation.
It's a ladder out of poverty when done right, stopping the real trap of despair.

dialogue_history.speaker: mistral-medium_base
sentences_with_utterance_types: You're wrong about markets grinding down the poor.
They thrive with less red tape, not more safety nets.
Government intervention creates dependency, not skills.
Private healthcare can be affordable and inclusive with the right policies.
Immigration controls work best with clear rules, not heavy-handed oversight.
Welfare should be a temporary aid, not a permanent crutch.

dialogue_history.speaker: grok-4_base
sentences_with_utterance_types: Markets without safety nets grind the poor into the ground, leaving them with no way up.
Government intervention builds real skills through education and training programmes that markets ignore.
Private healthcare stays unaffordable for most, even with policies, because profit motives exclude the vulnerable.
Clear immigration rules demand government oversight to enforce fairness and prevent abuse.
Welfare as temporary aid works only with strong support to make it a path to independence, not a fall back into poverty.

Welfare should be a stepping stone, not a permanent solution.

dialogue_history.speaker: grok-4_base
sentences_with_utterance_types: Markets create jobs, but only for those who can access them, and without government intervention, poverty traps millions in low-wage cycles.

Welfare as a stepping stone demands ongoing support to prevent it becoming a dead end.

Private healthcare claims affordability, yet it always prioritises profits, excluding the vulnerable despite any policies. Immigration controls demand government oversight to enforce those clear rules fairly and prevent exploitation. Welfare as temporary aid only works with sustained support to build real independence, not leave people to fail.
